author: Sideprojects
description:
From papal tantrums that split Christianity to a king stealing another man's fiancée and losing France, history's biggest changes often started with petty grudges. This episode explores feuds that shaped the Enlightenment, gave women the vote, created rival sportswear empires, redrew maritime boundaries, and even helped put Hitler in power.
